items.text: Booking went through in two minutes and the confirmation email arrived right away. Best experience I've had with a travel app.

The wifi code in the room was wrong, front desk gave me a new one. Sorted now.
The hotel you picked for us was perfect, walkable to everything and the staff knew our name at check-in.

Just to say the pickup driver called and I confirmed the time with him.
